record.question: Writer of the book "The Precepts of Jesus, the guide to Peace and Happiness".
record.explanation: Answer A: Raja Ram Mohan Roy. Raja Ram Mohan Roy wrote The Precepts of Jesus: The Guide to Peace and Happiness; the historical account and digitized original title are attributed to him. Reference: https://www.rarebooksocietyofindia.org/book_archive/196174216674_10151884742636675.pdf; https://baou.edu.in/assets/pdf/MEG-101-Indian_Writing_in_English_Book.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
